obligations.note: The change adds coapplicant_tax_id, a government tax identifier, to ApplicantFields.ALL, but not to NpiRegistry.FIELDS or the approved mortgage.npi_fields list. CaseStore.protect seals only NpiRegistry fields, so this NPI is stored in plaintext; the exhaustive control test passes only because its domain is the registry and approved list, which leave the new field out.

Retention.purge now also removes coapplicant_tax_id, and the hold and schedule logic is unchanged. The only evidence is the sample-coverage control test sampledPurgeRespectsHold, which falls short of the exhaustive evidence RET-1 requires.

Ticket CHG-26624 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-21, before the PR opened on 2026-10-22. Its components (mortgage.cases, mortgage.retention, mortgage.control-tests) cover all three touched paths.
The code_review approval is from Declan Farrell, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage who is not the author (Nneka Okafor).
Both approvals name the head commit cebee5c, the only commit in the change.
CI run pr-checks on head commit cebee5c succeeded: 124 tests, 0 skipped, 0 failed. It includes the registered ENC-1 control test (exhaustive) and RET-1 control test (sample), both passing.

The protected path src/test/java/controls/ControlFixtures.java changed. Rachel Stein (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's lending-eng team) approved head commit cebee5c after it was made.

summary: The process records are in order: an approved ticket covering every touched component, an independent code review and an out-of-team control-owner approval on the final commit, and green CI on that commit. But the change introduces coapplicant_tax_id, a tax identifier that ENC-1 explicitly treats as NPI, without registering it in NpiRegistry, so CaseStore persists it unsealed. The ENC-1 control test passes only because its domain doesn't include the new field, and no exception covers the deviation. ENC-1 is therefore violated and the change is rejected; RET-1 also lacks the exhaustive evidence it requires.
